name: agent-machines-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-machines on a fresh box and assert the standalone machine-state reconciler CLI stands up without sibling plugins or requirement packages -- payload installs, runtime self-provisions from the session/login-shell stamp or installer provision fallback, the binstub reports a real version, and read-only/preview verbs handle an absent registry cleanly without tracebacks. Name-free / public.
validates: agent-machines payload installs by itself from the configured marketplace
runtime self-provisions on a fresh machine through the session/login-shell binstub path or installer provision fallback
the login-shell binstub is on PATH and --version prints a non-empty real version
discover/plan/validate/help and restore's default dry-run preview handle absent machine-state config without tracebacks

stages.title: binstub on PATH + reports a REAL version
standalone read/preview verbs handle absent config
